value.rationale: Orthogonal Fourier character packing is a natural finite spectral invariant. Among the simplest nontrivially weighted full-affine-rank four-site samples, the two-pair symmetry produces a complete continuum phase diagram with two sharp transition ratios, an intermediate nonuniform regime admitting three characters but no basis, and an explicit one-frequency construction.
